card.name: Reassess and reflection words
card.fires_on: The ending of words about re-evaluating or reflecting, mostly the "ess" in reassess/re-assess in dosing instructions. Also fires on words like realization, examination, reflection and re-evaluate.

modes.description: The "ess" ending of reassess or re-assess in instructions to review the patient or the need for treatment.

modes.label: Reflection and realization
modes.description: Nouns or verbs of reflecting, realizing or re-evaluating in general prose.
modes.example: Stalin has finally come to the<< realization>> that this communist system is entirely inadequate.
